Requests session with retries
code:
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

def session(total=3):
    s = requests.Session()
    retry = Retry(total=total, backoff_factor=0.5, status_forcelist=[502, 503, 504])
    s.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))
    return s

Wait until a port is open
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
host=${1:-localhost}; port=${2:-5432}
for i in $(seq 30); do
  nc -z "$host" "$port" && exit 0
  sleep 1
done
echo "timeout waiting for $host:$port" >&2
exit 1

title: Nightly Postgres dump to S3
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
file="db-$(date +%F).sql.gz"
pg_dump "$DATABASE_URL" | gzip > "/tmp/$file"
aws s3 cp "/tmp/$file" "s3://$BUCKET/backups/$file"
rm "/tmp/$file"

title: Count orders per day
code:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, count(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
